gemini.description: Gemini (Nano Banana) images — high quality, multi-frame continuity. DEFAULT. Requires GEMINI_API_KEY.

anthropic.description: Claude Opus for narrative + Gemini for images. Premium storytelling quality.

veo.description: Video-based image generation - generates 8s videos, extracts last frame. Natural consistency!

krea.description: Krea 2 Medium images (~12s, style transfer for continuity) + Gemini narrative. Fast default. Requires KREA_API_KEY.

krea_large.description: Krea 2 Large images (~24s, higher quality) + Gemini narrative. Requires KREA_API_KEY.

fal.description: fal.ai SDXL Lightning images (~1-2s!) + Gemini narrative. SPEED preset - lower fidelity than Krea/Gemini. Requires FAL_API_KEY.

description: Using Gemini (Nano Banana) for high-quality, multi-frame-continuity image generation. Switch to krea/krea_large, fal (max speed), or openai/veo via /ai_switch.
